methodology.overhead_baseline: one native corrected atomic counter with two increment workers and a checker joining both; same three-worker/final-value behavior
methodology.overhead_difference: controlled run adds scheduling, snapshots, logical join and event recording; baseline has no exploration or tracing
methodology.overhead_order: alternating native/controlled order after five warmups per mode; times are single executions, not whole searches
